General Surgery at Silver Touch Hospitals

Not all procedures are major, but all procedures warrant skilled care.

Silver Touch Hospitals, a general surgery hospital in Ahmedabad, works with a highly skilled and experienced team of general surgeons who are adept at handling planned and emergency procedures with safety and precision.

From minor incisions to major abdominal surgeries, our emphasis is on comfort for patients, reduced recovery time, and long-lasting outcomes.

If you’re searching for a reliable general surgeon in Ahmedabad, we have specialist consultants trained in open as well as laparoscopic procedures.

Surgical Care That Covers the Bases

Our general surgeons operate on issues related to the abdomen, digestive system, skin, soft tissue, and others.

Some of the procedures most commonly performed are:

  • Appendicectomy
  • Hernia repair (open and laparoscopic)
  • Gallbladder removal
  • Piles and fistula management
  • Lump excision from the breast
  • Drainage of minor cysts, abscesses, and skin lesions

Each patient is carefully assessed prior to surgery. We always consider conservative treatments whenever feasible and keep you informed throughout the process.

General Surgery Hospital in Ahmedabad with State-of-the-Art Facilities and a Human Touch

Silver Touch Hospitals is recognised as a dependable general surgery hospital in Ahmedabad, equipped with modern operating theatres, trained surgical teams, and post-operative monitoring. Whether your procedure is day-care or requires a short stay, we maintain strict safety protocols and personalised care plans.

All our locations, including Satellite and Ranip in Ahmedabad, offer fast scheduling, affordable packages, and round-the-clock surgical support.Do you need the assistance of an experienced general surgeon in Ahmedabad? Visit your nearest branch of Silver Touch Hospitals.

faqs.q: Do I need a referral to meet a general surgeon?
faqs.a: No. You can arrange a consultation with our general surgery team directly over the helpline or website.

faqs.q: How long will I have to stay in the hospital after surgery?
faqs.a: This varies depending on the procedure. Some operations are performed as day-care, while others might necessitate one to three nights in the hospital.

faqs.q: Is laparoscopic surgery applicable to all conditions?
faqs.a: Few, but several operations, such as gallstone removal and hernia repair, can be performed laparoscopically (keyhole) for faster recovery.
